column2: Apps has frosted sidebar and opaque readable product area with working search and details.
Solid navigation is opaque and remains usable.
Light palette retains readable navigation, descriptions and focus.
Start Here has frosted welcome rail and all six destinations visible and internal application routes reachable.
Settings home has full-width sidebar search, no adjacent menu or short header divider, and a reachable footer menu.
Search, subcategory Back and the relocated application menu remain reachable.
Tray tooltip has visible space above the shelf; pointer movement dismisses it normally.
